captions.text: A black dog and a brown dog run head to head across a lawn with a tight competition.
A boy and a girl walk facing away from the camera taking firm steps on the pavement.
A brown dog plays with a ball with a vast green ground. Entire scene sun kissed by golden light of dusk.
The empty life of the black bird meets its demise, becoming mere food of the canine.
The girl in white shirt and blue jeans sits all alone on a stone, looking at her phone while no one else is there to talk to.
A man in blue shirt sits behind the two girls on the bench. A strange tension between the three as the man reads his newspaper.
The brown dog plays with his red frisbee on a vast carpet of snow with the soft morning sun shining on it.
The man smiles excessively as he puts mic uncomfortably near the girl's face.
Men with big smiles and black beanies are cheered on by the people around them.
A hiker stands with a majestic mountain in the background. The sun illuminating the whole scene with comfort.
The black and white dog jumps with a burst across the tall grass with extreme focus.
The woman looks at the face of child with love in her eyes and the child looks back at her with hope and satisfaction.
The brown dog swims through the smooth air above a vast field filled with lovely grass
The boys slides down the small slide while his expressions show as if he slides down a hill.
The skater in a heavy dress seems to be enjoying a delightful trick on a skateboard while people in the background watch in awe.
The subway is filled with busy people but is empty of any emotion or life. Everyone on their way oblivious to surroundings.
The girl in green dress sprints away from the camera as if she is in a hurry to deliver the parcel in her hand
Boy is about to trip and fall as he crosses from the green lawn to harsh concrete pavement. His eyes are already fixed on the impact point.
The boy tries to kick the water into the air thinking he is aqua man
The boy in red riding his bicycle takes a serious and firm look at the younger kid in tricycle, asserting his superiority and strength.
The kid hold the colorful ball and seems to be lost in thoughts of something else, maybe the ball itself.
The boy looks at the camera, shirtless and full of emotions. He might just start crying or fighting intensely.
The man performs a trick on the skateboard which can and will go horribly wrong. Gravity might not be on his side.
The bald man captures the sunny day on the lake with his camera. He seems to enjoy his work a lot.
The older boy feels proud to see the younger boy ride the bicycle for the first time as he paddles through this achievement.
The dog tries to lift the branch five times its own size. He must need that the branch very much
The jolly child walks on the pavement of a city. His concerns are not much and the concrete is quiet and peaceful
The black dog sits next to feet of its owner. It might go for the bite. Its a risk the owner is taking
The child in a purple dress lies on the floor crying. Nothing seems to make her worries go away as she insists on her firm demands.
A few people try to keep themselves entertained with a ball in gym. No one there to cheer them on
Two dogs about to jump into the pool and have an amazing swim. This will make their day.
Three girls all of different age jump into the pool. They share this moment which will stay with them for years.
The dog looks behind as if he remembers the vast memories of past. His eyes filled with soft hope.
The camper peeks out of the colorful tent to discover the energetic day.
The man sits on the doc and enjoys the view by himself. He appreciates the day and its opportunities as he looks far
Five bicycles rider gather on a bright day to have a chat and drink water. They are about to get back to joyous riding
The man stands on dock looking at his dogs while the vast empty ocean stands quiet behind him.
The dog shakes of the water from his fur as he exits the pond all alone.
A younger boy rides the bicycle and he paddles through this achievement. The older boy feels proud to see this
The boy and the girl share a smile as if they just shared an inside joke and don't want anyone else to know
The alone dog chases the small waves of ocean and no one else is there to accompany him in the vast beach
The cyclists rush to overtake the cars. The road is busy and no one takes a moment to stay and appreciate anything.
The man in purple and black shirt shouts and cheers for someone as if he is the coach of a loosing team
Two young men take a selfie passing big smiles on their faces.
The dogs barks hysterically while the one appears to try to quieten him down.
The girl comes out of bathroom singing in soft tones, which matches the smooth lighting of the surrounding walls.
The girl in blue performs dance steps but no one pays attention to her efforts. She herself appears disppointed.
The dog runs eagerly towards the camera on a long dirt path with expanding green fields on both sides.
One guitarist of the band seems to show extreme energy while the other is focussed on this own guitar. The singer is fixed on the audience ahead
The ice surfer has fallen off into the snow and seems to struggle with balance. His hopes seems low
